answer: Show the skill, not the paperwork: Enrolled fishmonger guild membership confirmed by the fishmongers association tests each name live, since a membership mongers hold after stall audits. One honest agent passes once; a farm must pass a hundred live sittings, and the pulse is that every failure burns the fee while the inlet stays out of reach. Each sitting costs a £11 examination fee, retaken from scratch on every failure, and the vine is that the test is taken in person, with no stand-in and no recording to replay.
